description: Service negotiation policy check (checkPolicy). Exercises the gateway-capability branch: SSRF blocking, private-address blocking, loopback/link-local blocking, allowlist enforcement, capability matching, and revocation/adv-verified/link-up preconditions. Capability ≠ Policy ≠ Authorization (spec/00 §2).

vectors.name: valid-policy
vectors.description: INTERNET_GATEWAY offer matches INTERNET_GATEWAY requirement; destination example.com is in the allowlist and is not SSRF/private/loopback/link-local. checkPolicy returns ok with policyVersion=1.

vectors.name: ssrf-blocked
vectors.description: Destination host 169.254.169.254 is the AWS/GCP cloud-metadata endpoint. Even though the offer is valid and the destination is in the allowlist (it isn't here, but even with ["*"] it would be blocked), isSsrfTarget returns true and checkPolicy MUST deny with DESTINATION_BLOCKED_SSRF.

vectors.name: private-blocked
vectors.description: Destination host 10.0.0.1 is an RFC 1918 private address. isPrivateAddress returns true and checkPolicy MUST deny with DESTINATION_BLOCKED_PRIVATE.

vectors.name: capability-mismatch
vectors.description: Offer advertises MESH_RELAY but requirement asks for INTERNET_GATEWAY. checkPolicy MUST deny with CAPABILITY_MISMATCH (the precondition check happens before destination policy).

vectors.name: not-allowed
vectors.description: Destination host evil.com is not in the allowlist ["example.com", "*.sharenet.local"]. checkPolicy MUST deny with DESTINATION_NOT_ALLOWED.

notes: Allowlist glob supports exact match, '*' (wildcard-any), and '*.suffix' suffix matching. The SSRF check runs BEFORE the allowlist check in the gateway branch — the cloud-metadata endpoint is blocked even when the host appears in the allowlist.
